description: Calves Born by Dam Breed Type to is a series of datasets listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Rural Payments Agency. "This dataset as reported to the Rural Payments Agency contains Cattle passport applications received for live and dead animals, Cattle born in Great Britain. Applications received by all sources Cattle Tracing System Online, Cattle Tracing System Web Services, SIS Email and Paper. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Rural Payments Agency. Its tags are Cattle Data, animal husbandry, environment. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
